{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) |versus_send_cost = {{Money|1,250}} |versus_wave_unlock = 20 |versus_eco = {{Money|5}} |versus_number = 1 |versus_timer = 3 }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Hero''' is an enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and also in [[The Takeover Event]]. It can also appear in Fallen Arena [[PVP]]. It has less health than the [[Fallen Giant]], but is significantly faster than it with 30% defense. It is also immune to being stunned, only being slowed down by stunning towers, it cannot be knocked back and it cannot be frozen. The '''Fallen Hero''' can be spawned by the [[Fallen King]] with its ''Summon'' ability and by the [[Awakened Fallen King]] with its ''Army of Chaos'' ability. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Heroes were soon-to-be Champions who answered the King's call to find a new source of magic. Though they returned empty-handed, they were the most promising warriors in the army and in line to become the next Champions. The curse bound them to eternal service for the King, transforming them much like the Fallen into mindless soldiers. They are now living embodiments of lost potential, forever denied the glory they were close to achieving.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Hero''' has black skin. It wears a blue and grey armor consisting of shoulder-pads, chestplate, leg padding, gloves and shoes. It wears a blue crown with four crystals on the sides. It also has a grey cape. It falls over when killed. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]] and [[Turret]] are recommended to take this enemy down. **The [[DJ Booth]], [[Commander]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to boost these towers. *The '''Fallen Hero''' is quite fast. Because of this, stalling towers like the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Tesla]] or [[Warden]] can be pretty useful against it. **Do note that because of its [[Stun Immunity]], it can only be slowed down instead of stunned by stunning towers and cannot be knocked back. *You can use defense dropping towers, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] to decrease this enemy's defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenHeroWalk.gif|Walking animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenHeroDeath.gif|Death animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FallenHero.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenHero.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Gatling Gun Tower - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Hero''' on a promotional video.
